opps.title: Teaneck Liquors — down 67% YoY
opps.body: Still ordering, but 2,744 cases lighter than last year (67%). It still does 1,373 cases a year for you, so the slide is worth about $2,744 in modeled commission. The drop is concentrated in Corona Extra (-1,062 cases), Modelo Especial (-851 cases) — a mix problem you can work on the next visit, not a lost account.

opps.title: 4 accounts holding all year but soft this month — 2,241 cases behind
opps.body: Year to date each of these is fine, so the relationship is not the problem — but month to date they are all well behind where they were last August. That is the pattern that becomes a bad quarter if nobody catches it, and it is the cheapest kind to fix: the account is still buying, it just has not placed its usual order yet. Together they are 2,241 cases and about $2,241 of commission behind last August's pace, with days left in the month to close it.

opps.title: 1 account stopped ordering — $25 of commission gone quiet
opps.body: Each of these bought from you last year and has ordered nothing at all in 2026. A lost account is the most expensive kind of decline: there is no brand mix to fix and nothing replaces it automatically — the whole relationship has stopped. The largest, Huel Deli & Grocery LLC, was worth 25 cases last year on its own. These are the calls with the shortest path back to commission, because the account already knows you.

opps.title: Total Wine & More (River Edge) alone is 21% of your commission
opps.body: One account carries 21% of your commission ($69,928 across 184 brands). Protecting this relationship is worth more than any new account you could open — and it is also your best test bed: a brand that works here is proven for the rest of the territory.

opps.title: Corona Extra alone is 20% of your commission
opps.body: Your top brand carries 20% of your commission and your top three carry 45%. That concentration cuts both ways: a single point move in Corona Extra is worth more to you than anything else on your board, so it deserves first call every week — and a supplier change or a lost placement there would hit harder than anywhere else in your book.
